future_check: Re-run the strict rival-witness census whenever canonical morphology or shape families change.
rationale: Each rival reproduces all five canonical outputs, so canonical fit alone cannot distinguish it from topology. Across 600 repaired draws, every scene contains a same-area/same-box 0/1 pair plus a noncanonical 0-hole shape, and the semantic gate verifies counterexamples for all three rivals.
summary: Area, bounding-box size, and canonical normalized shape are not the intended selectors.

future_check: Have the independent monitor confirm that every named canonical shortcut still fits all canonical pairs and fails at least one generated witness.
rationale: The repair resolves this for generated training lessons with explicit counterexamples, but it cannot alter the official canonical examples. Independent intake should therefore retain the named-rival evidence rather than treating canonical pair success as semantic proof.
summary: Canonical examples alone underdetermine topology versus three morphology lookups.

future_check: Any larger pattern must prove the complete exact override matrix at 30 seeds per band before widening or retaining the current bounds.
rationale: A first constant-time placement attempt at height 10 exposed 15 exact override rejections when two five-row components became adjacent. Raising the honest boundary to 11 made all 1,710 matrix draws pass and avoids unbounded backtracking.
summary: The minimum supported height is 11 so all transformed 0/1/2-hole profiles fit in distinct corners with a separating row.

future_check: Re-run selected exact sync plus execution parity after any canonical or task-local Racket edit.
rationale: Execution parity passes over all five canonical pairs and the only lint finding is an advisory style-eq-zero warning. Changing a correct synchronized oracle would add risk without improving semantics.
summary: No Racket patch is proposed; canonical, selected target, and archival source are byte-exact synchronized.

future_check: After adding any new shape profile, require equal area and equal bounding-box dimensions for the 0/1 pair and require all three canonical shortcut rivals to fail on that profile.
rationale: The five canonical pairs are all solved by area, bounding-box, and exact-template lookup shortcuts. Equal-area/equal-box pairs force those shortcuts to disagree with the authoritative hole-count rule while keeping all three true branches visible.
summary: Ordinary generated scenes pair the 0-hole and 1-hole components at identical area and bounding-box dimensions.
